EX-99.1 2 abos-20261026xexx991.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 Acumen Pharmaceuticals Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Business Highlights • Expect to report topline results for ALTITUDE-AD, a Phase 2 study to investigate sabirnetug (ACU193) for the treatment of early Alzheimer’s disease, in November 2026 • IND filing for the Enhanced Brain Delivery™ (EBD®)program lead clinical candidate targeted for mid-2027 • Cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities of $78.6 million as of September 30, 2026, expected to support current clinical and operational activities into early 2027 • Company to host conference call and webcast today at 8:00 a.m.

“In the third quarter, we continued readying for the readout from our ALTITUDE-AD Phase 2 study investigating the efficacy, safety and tolerability of sabirnetug for the treatment of early AD, and today I’m pleased to announce that we expect to report topline results in November 2026.

We continue to make progress on IND-enabling activities in support of a mid-2027 IND submission for a lead candidate and remain encouraged about the potential it holds as a next-generation Alzheimer’s disease treatment.” Anticipated Milestones • The Company expects to report topline results from ALTITUDE-AD in November 2026. ◦ ALTITUDE-AD is a 3-arm Phase 2 study investigating sabirnetug in 542 participants (N=180 per arm) for the treatment of early Alzheimer’s disease. ◦ ALTITUDE-AD includes two active doses (35 mg/kg, 50 mg/kg, IV Q4W) vs. placebo over an 18-month double-blinded period. ◦ Topline results are expected to include the iADRS (Integrated Alzheimer’s Disease Rating Scale), our primary clinical efficacy endpoint, as well as key secondary endpoints, such as CDR-SB (Clinical Dementia Rating – Sum of the Boxes), certain safety measures such as adverse event rates, including ARIA rates, and key biomarkers.
Topline results are expected in November 2026.

Forward-looking statements include statements concerning Acumen’s business, and Acumen’s ability to achieve its strategic and financial goals, including its projected use of cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities and the expected sufficiency of its cash resources into early 2027, the therapeutic potential of Acumen’s product candidate, sabirnetug (ACU193), including against other antibodies, the timing of anticipated topline results of ALTITUDE-AD, Acumen’s plans to develop a candidate to treat Alzheimer’s Disease utilizing EBD technology, including its expectations with respect to timing for the submission of an IND, the potential of its EBD candidates and the potential for developing a best-in-class therapeutic candidate for people living with Alzheimer’s Disease.
